$comment: Semantic router exemplars (owner decision 2026-10-24): a question's embedding is compared with these, as a second signal next to the deterministic routes in functions/_lib/scope.ts. They only add civic, learning and off-topic routes to questions the rules sent to the default route; they never decline a private topic (the HARD rules stay authoritative) and never answer one. Vectors live in content/generated/ask-embeddings.json (bun scripts/ask-embed.ts).
